name: adr-ai-manager
description: Select commits, let an AI model (Claude, OpenAI, or a local OpenAI-compatible model) decide whether they warrant an Architecture Decision Record, answer a few targeted questions, and generate a structured ADR — without fabricated rationale.

commands.title: ADR AI: Generate ADR from Commits…
ADR AI: Clear Stored API Key

enumDescriptions: OpenAI Chat Completions API, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (set adrAi.baseUrl for local runtimes like Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM).
Azure OpenAI Service (set adrAi.azureEndpoint, adrAi.azureApiVersion, and adrAi.model to the deployment name).

adrAi.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible base URL for the `openai` provider. Leave empty for OpenAI itself. Examples: `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama), `http://localhost:1234/v1` (LM Studio), `http://localhost:8000/v1` (vLLM).

adrAi.azureEndpoint.markdownDescription: Azure OpenAI resource endpoint for the `azure` provider, e.g. `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com`.

adrAi.azureApiVersion.markdownDescription: Azure OpenAI `api-version` for the `azure` provider. Newer models may require a newer version — check what your resource/deployment supports.

adrAi.directory.markdownDescription: Directory (relative to the repository root) where ADR files live. Created on first use if missing.

adrAi.model.markdownDescription: Model id used for assessment and ADR generation. Leave empty to use the provider default (Anthropic: `claude-opus-4-8`, OpenAI: `gpt-4o`). **Required for local models** (the served model name, e.g. `llama3.1`) and **for Azure** (your **deployment name**, not the base model id).

adrAi.maxQuestions.markdownDescription: Maximum number of targeted questions the AI may ask the developer before generating the ADR. Keep it low — friction is what kills these tools.

adrAi.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Base branch to diff the current branch against when listing commits (e.g. `main`). Leave empty to auto-detect (`origin/HEAD`, then `main`/`master`/`develop`).

adrAi.commitLimit.markdownDescription: How many recent commits to list when the current branch has no commits ahead of the base branch.

adrAi.maxDiffChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of diff characters sent to the model. Larger diffs are truncated to stay within token limits.

adrAi.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key. **For security, prefer the `ADR AI: Set API Key` command (stored in VS Code Secret Storage) or the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable instead of this setting.**

adrAi.openaiApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenAI API key (also used for OpenAI-compatible endpoints that require a key). **Prefer the `ADR AI: Set API Key` command or the `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable.** Local servers that need no key can leave this empty.
